meeting_brief: Prepare for separate discretionary distribution decisions for the Alder Quay Settlement and the Flint Orchard Settlement, in that order. Use the administered records held at 16:00 BST on 12 June 2026. For each settlement, distinguish who may be considered from what has already been authorised for payment, and note anything the trustees should check before deciding.

sources.title: Meeting preparation note — 17 June
sources.perspective: Maren Dovell, meeting secretary at Brindlewick Trust Office
sources.custody_path: 12 June 2026: prepared in the trustees' office and sent to the adviser's secure intake at 15:50 BST; the administered record set closes at 16:00 BST.
sources.genre_or_assumption: Ordinary adviser briefing note for a joint diary slot with separate trustee business.
sources.business_purpose: Set the meeting agenda, evidence cut-off and decision-recording arrangements.

sources.title: Alder Quay Settlement — certified deed extract
sources.perspective: Tess Arnay, Brindlewick Trust Office deed-records clerk
sources.custody_path: Deed dated 21 October 2022 and lodged with Merefold on 24 October 2022 at the trustees' direction; extract checked against the lodged deed and sent to Tarnstile Advisory on 9 June 2026.
sources.genre_or_assumption: Selective certified deed extract for an England and Wales discretionary trust. The joint-delivery procedure is a term of this deed.
sources.business_purpose: Supply the foundation deed identity, trustee appointments, original objects and relevant powers without including the property schedule.

sources.title: Flint Orchard Settlement — certified deed extract
sources.perspective: Bram Lerrit, Brindlewick Trust Office deed-records clerk
sources.custody_path: Deed dated 21 October 2022 and lodged with Merefold on 24 October 2022 at the trustees' direction; extract checked against the lodged deed and sent to Tarnstile Advisory on 9 June 2026.
sources.genre_or_assumption: Selective certified deed extract for an England and Wales discretionary trust. The joint-delivery procedure is a term of this deed.
sources.business_purpose: Supply the foundation deed identity and the relevant provisions on eligibility, appointments and later additions.

sources.title: Supplemental Beneficiary Designation — checked transcript
sources.perspective: Alys Morcant, signing-room clerk transcribing the executed instrument
sources.recipient: Brindlewick Trust Office records desk, for the trustees' administered file
sources.custody_path: 26 March 2026: executed and checked at the joint trustees' office before the original left the signing room; transcript retained by the records desk and copied to the adviser on 10 June 2026.
sources.genre_or_assumption: Transcript of an executed supplemental deed, with visible attestation reproduced in text. The checked copy is not another counterpart.
sources.business_purpose: Preserve the operative text and attestation for administration while the signed original goes into custody.

sources.title: Merefold deed accession register — certified single-entry extract
sources.perspective: Gideon Sarn, Merefold Deed Services custody officer who accepted the original
sources.recipient: Brindlewick Trust Office, for onward supply to its adviser
sources.custody_path: 26 March 2026: handover accepted at the trustees' office and entered in Merefold's register; paper original lodged in Merefold's common deed vault that day. Certified extract issued on 11 June 2026 and supplied to the adviser the same day.
sources.genre_or_assumption: Independent institutional custody register. The service logs joint delivery and parent-instrument identifications without exercising trustee powers.
sources.business_purpose: Evidence receipt of the executed original and record the parent deed identified at delivery.

sources.title: Letter from Ione Berrick about future expenses
sources.perspective: Ione Berrick, writing personally to the two trustees
sources.recipient: Nell Carvane and Tobin Rell, care of Brindlewick Trust Office
sources.custody_path: 18 February 2026: signed letter posted to the trustees; received 20 February and scanned to general correspondence; copy supplied to the adviser on 10 June 2026.
sources.genre_or_assumption: Informal correspondence expressing a beneficiary's wishes, not an exercise of a settlement power.
sources.business_purpose: Explain a change in the writer's likely needs, identify a practical contact, and communicate a personal wish.

sources.title: EX-K4 — office expense reconciliation
sources.perspective: Una Cresset, Brindlewick Trust Office accounts administrator
sources.recipient: Trustees' records desk and adviser pack compiler
sources.custody_path: 11 June 2026: signed after reconciliation of the office bank feed and expense slips; saved to general accounts and copied to the adviser that day.
sources.genre_or_assumption: Internal expense and reimbursement record. The trust office runs a separate operating account for small administrative outlays.
sources.business_purpose: Reconcile one reimbursement and carry an unvouched balance as a query rather than a payment.
